title: Back to the Beach | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled in the charming Highland Park neighborhood of Blue Mountain Beach, this coastal retreat offers the perfect setting for intimate family gatherings. With four bedrooms, an open-concept design, and space to comfortably sleep eight, it’s ideal for reconnecting with loved ones. The home’s inviting layout keeps everyone connected, while the screened-in porch provides a serene spot to relax with a morning coffee or evening glass of wine. Thoughtfully designed and equipped with everything needed for a seamless getaway, this home embodies laid-back coastal living at its finest.
